title: Implement root layout with sidebar navigation
description: Implement the root Next.js app layout (src/app/layout.tsx) with a sidebar navigation using shadcn/ui Sidebar. The sidebar contains links to Dashboard, Batches, and Settings. The main content area renders route children.
acceptanceCriteria: Root layout renders sidebar + main content area
Sidebar has links to: Dashboard (/), Batches (/batches), Settings (/settings)
Active route is visually highlighted in the sidebar
App name 'ProspectForge' is shown in the sidebar header
Layout is responsive (sidebar collapses on mobile)
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Wrap the page content in a sidebar layout using shadcn/ui's Sidebar components: `SidebarProvider`, `Sidebar`, `SidebarHeader`, `SidebarContent`, `SidebarMenu`, `SidebarMenuItem`, `SidebarMenuButton`. Import from `@/components/ui/sidebar`.

Create a `nav-links.ts` config with the navigation items: `[{ href: '/', label: 'Dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard }, { href: '/batches', label: 'Batches', icon: Users }, { href: '/settings', label: 'Settings', icon: Settings }]`. Use Lucide React icons.
Create a client component `AppSidebar` that uses `usePathname()` from `next/navigation` to determine the active route. Apply `isActive` prop to `SidebarMenuButton` for the current route.
Take a Playwright screenshot. Verify sidebar is visible with all 3 nav items. Click each link and verify navigation works. Check the active item is highlighted.

technicalNotes: The admin layout (with sidebar) should NOT apply to the /preview/* routes — those render full-width without admin chrome.
Create a separate layout for /preview/[slug] and /edit/[slug] that doesn't include the admin sidebar.
